residual_categorical.note: Every residual unresolved ID is categorically non-structured: Scheduled-source + downstream NLP/join (Enhanced Communication Log NLP and joins that touch a quarantined family — includes the deferred 75-ID NLP gate), Separate external source, Outside governed boundary, Unavailable/retention-limited, or Manual CRM inspection. join_note: No accepted-family cross-join is definition-exact: the held readers emit privacy-minimized dealer-week aggregates with NO shared row-level key exposed across families (no Lead ID / Sale ID / Appointment ID), so every join candidate fails on key/population/semantic alignment. The unused appointment fields completed/cancelled have no matching SW condition in the catalog; none is manufactured.
